id: P3 structural discrimination carries its non-replication qualification
why: the PRE-REGISTERED natural-power arm did not replicate; the clean pure-amplitude control that is silent was added post-hoc and is paradigm-specific. Quoting 14/15 without that is the site-vs-abstract divergence this gate exists to prevent.

id: P3 localization 10/15 is not sold as an advantage
why: a two-recording margin on fifteen is inside binomial noise; stating the win without that reads as a demonstrated performance advantage the benchmark does not support.

id: P3 structural-scenario win carries the pre-registered shortfall
why: the +0.25 margin falls short of the +0.30 threshold fixed in advance, so the advantage is real but not established at the pre-registered level.

id: P1 escape closure is stated conditionally, never as general
claim: closed by the \*same\* argument as the bounded cell
why: compactness moved from the state space to the observable; the closure holds for contracts factoring through a bounded reading and exhaustivity over admissible contracts is an open problem.

id: P1 first open problem records the pragmatic-I dilemma
claim: first open problem this argument leaves
why: under 2.2's pragmatic reading of I there may be no fact of the matter about admissible contracts, so exhaustivity may be declarable rather than provable. The dilemma must travel with the open problem.

id: P3 bundle apparatus carries its ablation result
why: the pre-registered fibre ablation found no material gain over the trace-normalized SPD base on the worked paradigm; the construction may not be presented as validated.

id: P3 localization counts carry the centring caveat
why: every within-trajectory localization window is symmetric about the true transition, so a centre-prior detector scores 22/22 there and 0/22 off-centre (localization_centerbias_control); any 10/15 localization figure quoted without that caveat reads as evidence the method localizes.

id: P1 limitative-theorems comparison is disclaimed where made
why: Section 2.1 denies formal kinship with the limitative theorems; any sentence invoking them must carry that disclaimer in the same paragraph.

id: P3 sleep discrimination carries the EOG attribution
why: the sleep covariance includes horizontal EOG, and with it removed the discrimination holds in only 2 of 4 subjects (discrimination_eog_ablation)
